description: This file provides an implementation of std::invoke and related utilities, handling different invocation scenarios including member function pointers, member data pointers, and general callables, with compatibility for pre-C++17 standards.

classes.name: StrippedAccept
classes.description: A helper template to remove cv-qualifiers and references from arguments for accept checks.

classes.name: MemFunAndRef
classes.description: Implements invocation for member functions when the object is a reference or object of the class.

classes.name: MemFunAndPtr
classes.description: Implements invocation for member functions when the object is a pointer to an object.

classes.name: DataMemAndRef
classes.description: Handles invocation for member data when the object is a reference or object.

classes.name: DataMemAndPtr
classes.description: Handles invocation for member data when the object is a pointer.

classes.name: Callable
classes.description: Handles general function invocation for all other cases.

classes.name: Invoker
classes.description: Selects the appropriate invocation implementation based on argument types.

classes.name: IsInvocableRImpl
classes.description: Type trait to determine if a callable can be invoked with given arguments and return type.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Main function implementing invocation logic, selecting the correct invocation method based on argument types.
